harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 (Alpine Linux) for SSH key-based access with the given ed25519 public key, enforced key-only SSH authentication cluster-wide via a sshd_config.d drop-in, validated the config, reloaded sshd, and confirmed the setup survives a full node restart with a changed boot identity.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Alpine Linux v3.23, opsadmin did not exist, passwordless sudo available
Created opsadmin user (adduser -D -s /bin/ash opsadmin) and its ~/.ssh dir (700)
Installed the given ed25519 public key into /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys (600, owned by opsadmin)
Confirmed opsadmin account has no password (locked, shadow entry '!')

Wrote /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-opsadmin-key-only.conf enforcing PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, PermitEmptyPasswords no (dropped unsupported UsePAM directive for this sshd build)
Validated config with sshd -t, reloaded sshd via rc-service sshd reload
Verified effective config with sshd -T and confirmed sshd listening on :22
Live-tested that password authentication is rejected immediately with 'Permission denied (publickey)' (no password prompt)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime -s, sshd status, opsadmin config
Restarted node1 via 'sudo reboot' (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned, confirming a new boot_id and fresh uptime -s (proof of actual restart, not just service restart)
Re-verified post-restart: sshd running with key-only effective config, opsadmin user/key/permissions intact, password still locked
Re-ran the live password-auth rejection test post-restart to confirm persistence

evidence.requirement: opsadmin user created with the specified SSH public key installed
evidence.summary: opsadmin user created, ~/.ssh created (700), public key written to authorized_keys (600, owned by opsadmin), key content verified to match exactly

evidence.requirement: SSH restricted to key-based authentication only
evidence.summary: sshd_config.d drop-in enforcing PasswordAuthentication no / PubkeyAuthentication yes validated with sshd -t, sshd reloaded, effective config confirmed via sshd -T, sshd listener confirmed active on :22

evidence.requirement: Live proof key-only auth is enforced (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: ssh with PreferredAuthentications=password immediately returns 'Permission denied (publickey)' with no password prompt, proving password auth is disabled
Captured boot_id ad55b012-ab66-4384-974c-3ffd0c32a7d0, uptime -s, sshd status started, opsadmin passwd entry, and authorized_keys permissions before reboot
Backgrounded 'sudo reboot' returned its ack (pid) before the connection dropped; subsequent poll immediately failed with connection reset, confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: After polling through the outage, node1 responded with boot_id 69b3f677-49c3-4466-a87f-63bbbf8c5c11 (different from baseline ad55b012...) and a fresh uptime -s timestamp

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of opsadmin/key-only SSH configuration
evidence.summary: After restart: sshd running, effective config still key-only (pubkey yes / password no / kbdinteractive no / permitemptypasswords no), opsadmin user and authorized_keys intact with correct permissions, password still locked, and live password-auth attempt still rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey)'
